about_the_game:
The ultimate successor to the beloved SimplePlanes! If you loved the creative freedom of the original, then get ready to take things to the next level in SimplePlanes 2.

EASY FOR NEWCOMERS, FAMILIAR FOR VETERANS

Whether you're a seasoned SimplePlanes builder or jumping in fresh, SimplePlanes 2 caters to you!

  • Intuitive Building: Snap parts together to create planes, cars, boats – let your imagination soar!
  • Download Community Crafts: If you don't fancy building, then download community made crafts and jump straight into the action.
  • Helpful Tutorials: Master the game quickly, no matter your experience level.
  • Familiar, Yet Improved Designer: We've enhanced the building experience while keeping it true to what you loved in the original.

EVERYTHING YOU LOVED – AMPLIFIED!

Everything players love about the first game is cranked up to the max in SimplePlanes 2. More parts, more environments, more features. More of what you want!

  • Enhanced Parts: Get ready for the new, highly customizable curved wing system, procedural jet engines, targeting pod, laser-guided bombs and rockets, underwater parts, aircraft textures, new and improved fuselages, and so much more.
  • New Environments to Explore: We've added the largest island yet where you can discover new cities, airports, and it's jam packed with exciting new challenges.
  • Multiplayer Mayhem: The most-requested feature is finally here! Fly and fight with friends, tackle challenges together, or just relax and explore the world.
  • Introducing Major Chad: He's your new in-game pilot, bringing fresh gameplay mechanics and a whole new personality to the world of SimplePlanes.
  • Improved Environmental Effects: Experience a richer atmosphere with volumetric clouds and fog, enhanced terrain textures, and a stunning new water system featuring waves and underwater effects.
  • Backwards compatibility: Fly your SimplePlanes 1 crafts in SimplePlanes 2 with no fuss, no extra work, no shenanigans. Breathe new life into them by upgrading them with new parts and textures.*
  • Improved Visual and Audio Effects: Everything looks and sounds better, from improved environments to stunning visual effects like explosions and smoke trails.

* We are doing our best to support as many crafts from SimplePlanes 1 as possible, but we cannot guarantee that every craft will work exactly as it did in SimplePlanes 1.

  • Processor: Intel or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal, 3GB VRAM

Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal, 4GB VRAM
